Instructions – To Be Strictly Followed:
1) Please ensure you carry the following documents with you to the Test Center, on the day of exam:
a) Printed copy of Admit Card (Pls note- A copy of the physical/hard copy of your Admit card is mandatory for admission into the examination
venue). You must carry one photo and paste the same on the Hall ticket at the exam venue)
b) Original Government issued Photo Identity proof for verification, such as Aadhaar Card / Driving License / Passport / Voter ID / PAN Card
only. ID card with incomplete DOB details will not be considered valid. (Note: The ID card must have the complete DOB details,
including date, month, and year.)
2) Report to the test centre well before the gate closure time, otherwise entry will NOT be permitted.
3) Prohibited Items: DO NOT wear any jewellery or other items containing metal. Bags, Mobile phones or any other electronic gadgets such as
Smart watches, Digital Key, calculators and other electronic devices are strictly prohibited in the examination hall. There is no facility for
safekeeping of your personal belongings outside the test hall and we are not responsible for its loss. Only Admit Card, original Photo ID Card &
Photo will be allowed inside the test hall.
4) Unfair Means: Adoption of any unfair means in the examination hall will result in disqualification from the test and your scores will not be
published. You will also not be able to participate in any subsequent selection process or tests.
5) Request for change of test centre will NOT be entertained.
6) Friends and relatives accompanying the candidate will NOT be allowed inside the test centre.
You will NOT be permitted to appear for the Exam if you fail to carry the Admit Card, photo and/ or any one of the mandatory
Government issued Photo Identity Card.
Declaration:
I hereby certify that I meet the eligibility criteria to take the test and the information furnished by me in the Registration/Application Form is

my scores obtained in the test can be withheld / or invalidated.
